lines.text: all things are become slippery & we cannot hold them

behold we are surrounded byDemons yea we are encercled about by the angels of him who hath sought to destroyour souls behold our iniquities are great O Lord canst thou not turn away <​thine angar​> from us &this shall be your language in them days but

behold your days of probation is passed ye have procrastinated the day of your Salvation untill it is everlastingly to late & your destructionis made sure yea for ye have sought all the days of your lives for that which ye couldnot obtain & ye have sought for happiness in doing iniquity which thing is conterary tothe nature of that righteousness which is in our great & eternal head O
ye People ofthe land that ye would hear my words & I pray that the angar of the Lord be turned awayfrom you & that ye would repent & be saved &
